notes_for_editor: Thin record. The sources are the Forest Lookouts listing (patrol lookout, survey 47N-1E-31), a firelookout.com mention of a patrol point on Reeds Baldy 2 miles northeast of St. Joe Baldy, the Idaho climbing guide and PeakVisor. Two web searches and the cache found no build date, design, staffing, fires or summit structure, so the story has no history section. Elevation disagrees: 6,153 ft (climbing guide) against 6,132 ft (PeakVisor); the story reports both and no elevation fact is stored because there is no elevation key. The record's coordinates (47.37547, -116.37628) match the climbing guide and PeakVisor within about 10 m. Reeds Baldy is not in the FFLA Benewah County list (firelookout.org, Idaho by county); that is noted here only, not stated in the story. A 1959 St. Joe National Forest atlas sheet on historicmapworks labels Reeds Baldy; it was not read.
